svg.text: Final high-level design | Read numbered cards: Row 1 left-to-right →, Row 2 right-to-left ←, Row 3 left-to-right →. Lower panels show deployment boundaries and recovery paths.
Customer-facing path is fast and bounded; order creation, authorization and capture are asynchronous after checkout acceptance. Row directions are explicitly serpentine.
Queue polls served from cached watermark; jittered
PAUSED: preserve place; issue no admission token
Terminal SOLD_OUT returns a final queue answer
Publishes 1s watermark + admission gate from HA CTRL
PAUSED admission gate is not terminal SOLD_OUT
Pause on unknown stock, PSP breaker / cap, lost CTRL
or stale / missing remote standby ACK
Waiting room returns short-lived signed token
Status + PSP webhook use separate auth
Priority rate limits and load shedding
Any unit: walk from hash(user_id) % S
Bound shard drains → SOLD_OUT; never remap
Lua: unit → HELD with TTL + deadline
Reaper never frees PAYING on timer evidence
One active lease owner per Redis stream
Publish then ACK only after broker ACK
Pending entries replayed after relay restart
Retry → requeue → DLQ; offset after durable outcome
Local WAL flush only: PENDING_PAYMENT + INTENT
Not yet cross-region durable or CONFIRMED
Unique conflict → CANCELLED; short-circuit, NEVER PSP
Metadata: item / unit / user / home region / epoch
Query/retry same key; void before cancel/release
CAS AUTHORIZED + CONFIRMED only after PSP auth
Remote standby WAL-flush ACK; primary + standby (2-of-2)
No ACK → pause confirms and new admissions
Expose/project CONFIRMED only after durable commit
Pre-ACK region loss: REC rebuilds from PSP metadata; void orphan auth
After remote ACK: mark Redis unit sold; never re-offer
Unique loser: short-circuit from 11; NEVER calls PSP
KV fast path; monotonic status version
HOME REGION — SINGLE WRITER FOR THIS ITEM
Two home-region AZs; stateless app replicas and leased workers in both; item ownership is fenced.
No role pinned to AZ a
Same worker roles as AZ a
On AZ loss: surviving replicas take over only after lease + fencing checks; checkout / payment work remains idempotent.
Inventory, admission control, durable ownership, event log and projections have separate responsibilities.
PSP capacity + remote standby ACK health
≤50K simultaneous live owners per hot item
SUPPORTING FLOWS, EXTERNAL SYSTEMS AND RECOVERY
dedupe event ID; bypass waiting room
Polling by the same idempotency key is the fallback for
missing or late callbacks. PSP timeout is UNKNOWN, never decline.
WRK → dedicated HA CTRL breaker/capacity → ADM → watermark;
DB publishes standby-ACK health; stale/missing health pauses new admits.
MEM publishes stock summary into CTRL; inventory shards stay separate.
KV: PENDING after local DB commit; CONFIRMED after remote ACK;
CANCELLED after definitive failure; CAPTURED after CAP DB CAS.
HoldPayOverdue and failed payment events are resolved against
durable order/payment state and PSP truth before release.
all writes forward to home gateway
Primary + one remote standby are both required (2-of-2), not majority quorum.
WAN/standby ACK loss pauses confirmations and new admission tokens.
PAUSED preserves queue place; browse remains available.
PAYING holds stay locked; REAP emits HoldPayOverdue via Redis outbox,
then RLY -> Kafka -> WRK/REC; PAYING is never timer-released.
Step-11 INTENT is local WAL only, not remote durable.
On region loss after PSP auth but before step-13 ACK:
fence old writer; acquire higher epoch; query PSP by idempotency key.
Recover metadata; verify standby commit; reconstruct missing recovery record.
Void orphan auth; reconcile DB / PSP ledger / inventory before reopening.
PSP metadata must be queryable by key; OTel / Prometheus never gates sale.
Strict invariants: no duplicate live unit owner • no duplicate PSP effect per idempotency key • CONFIRMED only after remote WAL flush ACK • failures prefer temporary undersell.
